acceptance.given: A replay or Matrix result is serialized or interpreted through the repository-owned replay entrypoint.

oracle.expected: The terminal-category validator admits only pass, comparison-failed, invalid-input, identity-invalid, evidence-invalid, stale, execution-failed, timed-out, and expected-difference only when the Matrix rules explicitly permit it; versioned aliases preserve the represented category and never convert a failure into pass.
forbidden: An undeclared terminal category is accepted.
A serialized alias converts a failure to success.
A serialized alias silently changes a declared category's meaning.
expected-difference is accepted outside its permitted Matrix context.
oracle.observable: The focused replay test exercises declared categories and alias mappings, observing acceptance of valid preserved mappings and rejection of undeclared, success-forging, or category-reinterpreting values.

acceptance.then: Terminal-category validation returns only contract-preserving results or fails closed.
acceptance.when: The result producer serializes a terminal result, or a consumer parses a serialized terminal category.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the focused terminal-category closure assertions with an undeclared category and aliases that respectively forge pass or reinterpret a declared failure category.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add a closed terminal-category and versioned-alias interpretation boundary to the Toolchain replay result path: only declared terminal categories are emitted or accepted, expected-difference is admitted only under its Matrix rule, and aliases must preserve rather than reinterpret failure semantics.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Existing serialized receipts remain readable only through explicit versioned aliases that preserve their terminal category; unknown, ambiguous, success-forging, and semantic-reinterpreting values fail closed.

slice_hint.state_transition: An unconstrained serialized result category becomes a validated canonical terminal category or a rejected invalid result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every replay and Matrix terminal result is one declared category, with expected-difference limited to its permitted Matrix case; no alias can merge failure into pass or change category meaning.
